grant_type.description: The grant type. Only `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange` is supported.

subject_token.description: The token to exchange. Required for the token exchange grant. At most 16 KiB.

subject_token_type.description: The type of the subject token. Required for the token exchange grant. `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt` for all workload identity providers, or `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token` for `OIDC` providers.

requested_token_type.description: The type of token to issue. Optional. Only `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token` is supported.

service-account-name.description: The name of the service account, without the reserved `svc:` prefix.

workload-identity-provider-name.description: The name of the workload identity provider.
